sources.paraphrase: em uses computed font-size; metric units have separate font inputs. Minimum-font-size restrictions are used-value restrictions.
Registered length em introduces FontSize dependency. A custom-relative font-size can create a genuine cycle; the literal size in the fixture supplies no such reverse reference.
Typed attribute processing resolves substitutions and parses requested syntax; successful type parsing does not itself guarantee consuming-property grammar validity.

scope: Primary spec bounds for existing fixture, not a new exhaustive spec-trace verdict or proof of Gecko scheduling.
